messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@sparkscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options — SparkScale

Hi Daniel / Olivia —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for walking through the SparkScale inference use case. Quick recap and the asks I promised to follow up on so we can get pricing locked in: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Workload: low-latency chat assistants and batch embedding/rerank for search.
- Current prod footprint: small pilot (non-critical) with ~10M tokens/month today, expect ramp to ~100M tokens/month within 6–9 months if early results look good.
- Peak concurrency: typical per-user requests are short (avg 150 tokens) but spikes during batch jobs.
- Security: VPC + SOC2 acceptable; will discuss Private deployment later.

Pricing / commercial asks you mentioned:
1) Target unit economics: aim for $/1M tokens in a range that makes inference economical for you (you mentioned a target around $50–$100 per 1M tokens).
2) Startup program / credits for first 3 months to de-risk pilot.
3) Committed-use discount for a 12–24 month term once you hit committed volumes — looking for something meaningful (multi-year incentive).

Next steps we propose:
- You confirm expected committed baseline (monthly tokens) and target $/1M tokens you need to achieve.
- I’ll pull together a pro-forma: best-effort pricing for hosted API vs Dedicated baseline + committed discounts and startup credits.
- If numbers look good, I’ll send the formal term sheet + DocuSign for a 12-month commitment.

Attachments: I’ve attached our standard startup program summary + a blank pro-forma (will populate after you confirm numbers).

Action items for you: please reply with the committed baseline you’re comfortable guaranteeing (or a range), and the budget bucket you’re targeting for $/1M tokens. If you prefer, a one-line answer like “baseline 50M/month, target $60/1M” is perfect.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@sparkscale.com>

Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sparkscale.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options — SparkScale

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and sorry for the delay. Quick answers below: 

Committed baseline: we can commit to 25M tokens/month for the first 3 months of a paid pilot. If the pilot demonstrates parity on latency and cost, we expect to ramp to ~75–100M tokens/month by month 6 and to ~250–300M/month at steady state within 12 months.

Target unit economics: our finance and ops teams gave us a guide — we need pricing around $60/1M tokens to make the economics work for our product roadmap. Above $100/1M the business case is pretty tight.

Startup ask: we’d appreciate a startup credit for the first 3 months to cover the pilot (even a partial credit helps).

Committed term: we’re open to a 12–18 month committed contract if the committed baseline and pricing look reasonable. For a 12-month committed-use, we’d expect a material discount vs pay-as-you-go (asking in the ballpark of 25–35%). For 24 months, we could consider a higher discount (35%+).

Let me know if you want to hop on a quick 15-min call today to go through the pro-forma.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Kim | Head of Platform Engineering, SparkScale
daniel.kim@sparkscale.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@sparkscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing & committed-use options — SparkScale

Thanks Daniel — this is super helpful. I pulled together two scenarios and attached a populated pro-forma (see Pro-Forma-Pricing.xlsx):

Scenario A — 12-month commitment (baseline 50M/month)
- Committed baseline: 50M tokens/month
- Starter credit: 3 months of 50% credits on usage (to de-risk pilot)
- Discount: 30% off standard hosted rates on committed volumes
- Effective target: if we apply 30% and your target $60/1M, we can get close to $42/1M on committed volumes (actual depends on model mix — embeddings vs generation).

Scenario B — 24-month commitment (baseline 75M/month)
- Committed baseline: 75M tokens/month
- Starter credit: 3 months 75% credits on committed baseline
- Discount: 40% off standard hosted rates
- Effective target: brings per-1M closer to $36/1M in some cases.

Notes:
- These are hosted API numbers; Dedicated or Private (VPC) have different pricing + infra fees. If you need private, we can model that too.
- I’ve looped Ben (cc) for approval on the startup credit and to confirm that 30–40% is within the typical committed discount band for deals at your scale.

Next steps: Can you confirm which scenario you prefer (A vs B), and whether the baseline assumptions align with what you can commit to? If yes, I’ll prepare a term sheet and send to you for signature.

Attaching: Pro-Forma-Pricing.xlsx (populated), Redwood-Startup-Program-Terms.pdf

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — I reviewed the two scenarios with Olivia and we prefer Scenario A to start (12-month commitment) assuming the committed baseline can be set to 50M/month as you modeled. Two quick asks before signing: 
1) Can you confirm a hard cap on overage pricing for the first 3 months? We need predictability in case of bursty usage.
2) Can we get the startup credit structured as an invoice credit (not applied as a rebate)? Easier for our accounting team.

If you can confirm those two points, we’re ready to take a term sheet and move to signature this week.

–Daniel
